protocol: §6.N Recurring Bluff Hunt — DATA-INTEGRITY layer (Kotlin Room persistence). Worktree agent-ac74e99544b101d5a. SAFE evidence-only: production code mutated-then-reverted during rehearsal; only a new test + this evidence file are committed.
layer: data-integrity (persisted/observable Room state — highest-severity class: a bug = data loss / wrong persisted state)
tooling: GOMAXPROCS=2 ./gradlew :core:data:testDebugUnitTest --tests <T> --max-workers=2 (real in-memory Room DB via Robolectric)
selection_rationale: Filter 'would a bug here be invisible to existing tests?' — both targets answer YES. core/database/converters/Converters.kt (Room TypeConverters for the Author/Category columns) had ZERO test before this hunt; the only converter tests live in core/data/converters and cover DIFFERENT converters (EndpointEntity/Forum/Post/etc.). The single existing real-Room test (FavoriteVisitedProviderIdMigrationTest) only ever writes NULL into the author/category columns, so a converter round-trip bug was wholly invisible. The VisitedTopicDao/FavoriteTopicDao ORDER BY + REPLACE-on-conflict SQL had no DAO-level behavioral test either.
new_test_baseline: 6 tests — BUILD SUCCESSFUL against unmutated production code before any mutation.

targets.production_under_test: Converters.fromAuthor / toAuthor (Room @TypeConverter) — serialise the non-null Author column of FavoriteTopicEntity + VisitedTopicEntity to/from JSON text on disk. A round-trip bug silently corrupts persisted bookmark/favorite/visited author metadata.
targets.pre_hunt_coverage: NONE — the Converters object in core/database had zero tests; the existing real-Room migration test only writes NULL into the author/category columns so the converter code path never executed in any test.
targets.mutation_applied: In Converters.fromAuthor, removed `value.avatarUrl?.let { put("avatarUrl", it) }` so the avatar URL is dropped on write (a real data-loss bug for every saved topic with an avatar).
targets.test_outcome_after_mutation: fail (CLEAN) — 6 tests completed, 1 failed; BUILD FAILED
targets.observed_failure_verbatim: TopicEntityPersistenceIntegrityTest > favorite Author and Category survive a real Room round-trip FAILED — org.junit.ComparisonFailure: persisted Author.avatarUrl must survive the Room JSON round-trip expected:<https://img.example/avatar.png> but was:<null>

targets.production_under_test: VisitedTopicDao.observerAll (ORDER by timestamp DESC — newest-first visited-history list order) + FavoriteTopicDao.insert (@Insert onConflict=REPLACE — primary-key dedup the favorites screen depends on; Third Law explicitly calls out duplicate-rejection as a fake-can-hide-it class).
targets.pre_hunt_coverage: NONE at the DAO/SQL level — no test exercised the actual ORDER BY or the REPLACE conflict strategy against a real Room DB.

mutations_applied.mutation: VisitedTopicDao.observerAll: ORDER by timestamp DESC -> ASC (visited history rendered oldest-first — a user-visible list-order corruption).
mutations_applied.test_outcome_after_mutation: fail (CLEAN) — TopicEntityPersistenceIntegrityTest > visited history is ordered newest-first FAILED
mutations_applied.observed_failure_verbatim: java.lang.AssertionError: visited list must be newest-first (timestamp DESC) expected:<[vis-new, vis-mid, vis-old]> but was:<[vis-old, vis-mid, vis-new]>

mutations_applied.mutation: FavoriteTopicDao single-entity insert: onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE -> IGNORE (a re-saved favorite with the same id keeps the stale row instead of updating it).
mutations_applied.test_outcome_after_mutation: fail (CLEAN) — TopicEntityPersistenceIntegrityTest > re-saving a favorite with the same id replaces the old row FAILED
mutations_applied.observed_failure_verbatim: org.junit.ComparisonFailure: a re-saved favorite (same id) must REPLACE, not duplicate or keep the stale row expected:<Updated title> but was:<Original title>

targets.post_revert: git checkout VisitedTopicDao.kt FavoriteTopicDao.kt → BUILD SUCCESSFUL (6/6)

summary.verdict: Both data-integrity targets were previously UNTESTED at the persistence layer (Converters object: zero tests; DAO ORDER BY / REPLACE: zero behavioral tests). This hunt is a GAP-CLOSED outcome (not GENUINE — there was no pre-existing test to validate, nor a surviving bluff to remove). The new TopicEntityPersistenceIntegrityTest exercises the REAL AppDatabase (real SQLite via Robolectric, real DAOs, real Converters; no fakes) and provably bites on all three deliberate data-corrupting mutations — dropped avatarUrl, reversed list order, broken REPLACE dedup — each failing with a clear primary-on-persisted-state assertion (Sixth Law clause 3) and passing again after revert. The highest-severity class (data loss / wrong persisted state) now has a falsifiable guard.
summary.constitutional_compliance: Second/Third Law (real Room + real DAOs + real converters, no fakes); Sixth Law clause 3 (primary assertion on persisted DB row fields); §6.T.1 (a converter/ordering/dedup bug corrupts user lists — this is the guard); §6.N.1 (data-integrity layer not yet hunted this cycle).
summary.production_code_state: all production reverted via git checkout; only the new *Test.kt + this evidence file are committed.
